description: This file defines the interface for an object ID set, providing functions for initialization, insertion, removal, containment checks, comparison, parsing from files, and iteration. It is part of a system that manages collections of object IDs efficiently using a hash table.

classes.name: struct oidset
classes.description: A structure representing a set of object IDs, internally wrapping a hash table of OIDs.

classes.name: struct oidset_iter
classes.description: Iterator structure for traversing the elements in an oidset.

methods.name: oidset_init
methods.description: Initializes an oidset with optional preallocation.

methods.name: oidset_contains
methods.description: Checks if an oidset contains a specific object ID.

methods.name: oidset_insert
methods.description: Inserts an object ID into the set; returns 1 if already present, 0 if inserted.

methods.name: oidset_insert_from_set
methods.description: Inserts all object IDs from one set into another.

methods.name: oidset_remove
methods.description: Removes an object ID from the set.

methods.name: int oidset_size(const struct oidset * set)
methods.description: Returns the number of object IDs in the set.

methods.name: oidset_clear
methods.description: Removes all elements and frees related resources.

methods.name: oidset_parse_file
methods.description: Reads object IDs from a file into the set.

methods.name: oidset_parse_file_carefully
methods.description: Reads object IDs from a file with a callback for custom handling.

methods.name: void oidset_iter_init(const struct oidset * set,struct oidset_iter * iter)
methods.description: Initializes an iterator for traversing the set.

methods.name: struct:object_id * oidset_iter_next(struct oidset_iter * iter)
methods.description: Returns the next object ID in iteration.

methods.name: struct:object_id * oidset_iter_first(struct oidset * set,struct oidset_iter * iter)
methods.description: Resets iterator and returns the first element.
